title: A document past the ceiling in bytes but not in characters
why: Both other document-size cases pad with ASCII, where UTF-8 byte length, JavaScript string length and Kotlin string length are the same number — so an engine measuring characters or UTF-16 code units passes them and then accepts a document whose encoded bytes are over the cap. `maxDocumentBytes` is a count of **bytes**, which is what a reader has to bound before it fetches, and this is the case that says so.
